notes: Partition verified: s001–s013 and t001–t015 each appear once.
The existential אַיִן carries its supplied dummy and copula and heads on the negation word (rule 50); ʾāḏām takes the supplied indefinite article discontinuously around the adjective (rules 15, 25).
